issues.title: Dispatcher Pipeline Bypass
issues.description: The Dispatcher takes on small tasks directly instead of following the strict lifecycle.
requirements: Update the Dispatcher's system instructions (AGENTS.md and/or SKILL rules) to explicitly ban direct code execution, even for trivial tasks.
Enforce that all tasks must pass through the pipeline (Investigate → Planning → Execution → Documentation → Verification) using appropriate workers.

issues.title: Config UI Deficiencies
issues.description: Config form fails to populate current opencode.jsonc data and lacks fields for Provider, URL, Key, and Model selection.
requirements: Update ConfigPage to correctly parse existing opencode.jsonc data, including comments (JSONC), and populate component state.
Add a dropdown for 'Provider Type' (e.g., anthropic, openai, custom).
Add inputs for Base URL and API Key.
Add dropdowns to select models for specific worker roles (Thinker, Crafter, Sprinter) by auto-detecting models from the selected provider.
Ensure saving the config preserves the JSONC structure or writes a valid JSON payload that opencode supports.

issues.title: Config File Integrity
issues.description: User's opencode.jsonc appears missing or wiped out.
requirements: Create a health-check/repair script to verify the existence of ~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc or ~/.opencode.jsonc.
If missing, auto-generate a valid fallback opencode.jsonc file with default values.
Update the dashboard backend/API to handle missing config gracefully by returning the default structure rather than failing.
